en: Vintage monochrome postcard view of a town square showing a large civic building with a steep hipped roof, dormers and central entrance, likely the town hall, and in front of it a tall war memorial column topped with an eagle sculpture. The scene includes a few people in the street and trees and houses receding into the distance. The caption printed at the top left reads "Dommitzsch a. Elbe."
